method: Reference baseline/line boxes measured from unchanged-layout browser copy. Native text baseline is inferred from actual drawn Label geometry and the installed Creator 3.8.8 centered single-line alphabetic formula: centerY + 0.37*fontSize; not a pixel-extracted baseline. One actual physical pixel is added as a conservative rounding bound. Footer CSS padding excluded from text-line center. Decorative star/arrow centers are asserted separately in C14/C15. Actual screenshots inspected for clipping and legibility; human acceptance remains pending.
